text:
maria.g: quick standup — what I did: finished the preflight for the new eu-west1 pool, ran quota checks, validated autoscaler policy. blockers: waiting on quota bump in ap-southeast1 from cloud team (they asked for exact req). today: coordinate quota request + smoke test on canary nodes.

jonathan: thanks — can you paste the quota numbers you requested? i can escalate if it's precise.

maria.g: asking for 32 x nvidia-a100-40gb reserved (dedicated) in ap-southeast1, plus 128 vGPU minutes for burst. told them we need it by EOD Fri.

lee: FYI current project quotas (last sync):
`ap-southeast1: GPUs=8/8 (limit), reserved=2`
`eu-west1: GPUs=40/20 (used/softlimit?)` — that eu-west1 line is weird, i'm following up with cloud acct.

anya: heads up, ran a spot-preempt test overnight, saw ~12% preemptions on a100_spot in ap-southeast1 between 02:00-03:00 local. if we rely on spot for burst, bump fallback capacity. :warning:

maria.g: noted — we should pin canary to reserved nodes for now. jonathan can you open the quota ticket with the numbers (i'll add justification + SLO link)?

jonathan: on it. filing now and cc'ing cloud-ops. ticket link: https://cloud.internal/tickets/RED-4123

lee: quick note on autoscaler: lowered `maxSurge` to 10 to reduce transient cost spikes during scale-ups. will monitor today.

infra-bot: autoscaler-alert: scale-up event in eu-west1 (pool-eu-1) +18 nodes at 2026-03-17T10:08:12Z — avg latency improved, cost delta ~+3.2% last hour.

maria.g: thanks all. next steps: jonathan — escalate quota; lee — keep telemetry on surge; anya — share preempt metrics in #incidents if it keeps spiking. i'll run canary deploy once quota confirmed. :thumbsup:
